title: Plan class: general (shared acceptance invariants)
description: Class rubric for general plans' acceptance rubrics (5 criteria, pass/partial/fail/unknown): every deliverable backed by a durable, current citation, the outcome meets the stated request, rulings recorded as decisions, discoveries filed, and the independent grader spot-checks the implementer's audit citations. Investigation is a general sub-class (plan-verification-profiles-2026-10-17 D-003).
